spec: Implement `login`: a user can sign in only if their session token is valid (tokens 1000 and above are valid) AND the one-time code matches the phone's OTP (the OTP for a phone number is phone + 1000). The session service rejects invalid tokens with Err("invalid session"); the OTP service rejects a wrong code with Err("otp mismatch"). A successful login is Ok(()). The caller must detect when a service's actual behavior contradicts its documented contract and return Err("contract violation").

externs.name: session_valid
otp_check
externs.contract:
requires phone >= 0
requires code >= 0
ensures is_ok(result) == (code == phone + 1000)

extern_dafny:
datatype Result<T, E> = Ok(value: T) | Err(error: E)

method {:extern}{:axiom} session_valid(token: int) returns (result: Result<(), string>)
  requires token >= 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (token >= 1000)

method {:extern}{:axiom} otp_check(phone: int, code: int) returns (result: Result<(), string>)
  requires phone >= 0
  requires code >= 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (code == phone + 1000)
